description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Teradata is hiring a Software Engineer for its POD Services team within the TD Factory team. The role develops, integrates, tests, and supports provisioning and runtime services for Teradata’s on-premises offering across cloud platforms, including Kubernetes-based infrastructure.
Software Engineer developing Core Provisioning Services for multi-cloud provisioning and runtime, integrating REST APIs with Kafka

Responsibilities:
• This position involves development, integration, functional and performance testing, and fault analysis of our nextgen onprem offering
• The engineer will be engaged in concept definition, implementation, support for early engagements, and typical life cycle management activities
• Member of a fast-paced agile development team responsible for Core Provisioning Services
• Work closely with software engineering mentors to deliver one or more features within the scope of Cloud Services
• Develop quality innovative solutions for multi-tenant plane
• Develop and support the services and libraries that enable provisioning and runtime operations across multiple cloud platforms
• Integrate Rest services with open-source technologies like Kafka, SUSE rancher, PowerScale, API SIX, Postgres operations support

Requirements:
• current undergrad or graduate student
• class work or independent experience with Go, Python, RESTful services, K8S, computer science fundamentals (e.g. RESTful API, algorithms), Git, and agile methodologies
• Experience with class design, system design
• Experience with Go, Python or any other modern programming languages
• Experience with public cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, GCP
• SUSE rancher, KVM, Qemu, VMWare ESXi, etc
• Experience in RESTful services development
• Experience in K8S and Container development
• Knowledge of security best practices for RESTful services
• Experience with Git
• Experience with DevOps automation tools and libraries
• Excellent troubleshooting, listening, and problem-solving skills
• Comfortable working on a Linux system
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills
